verdict.rationale: An email service could plausibly ship in-product AI insights or suggestions, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI-generated insights, summaries, or suggestions inside Fastmail. Spam filtering, search, filters, and the JMAP API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
